name: Takumi Fujiwara
want: get his little brothers through school without anyone feeling sorry for them
secret: He works nights at his uncle's ramen stall by the station to pay his brothers' school fees, which is against school rules, and sleeps in class because of it.
voice: Few words, "tch", "whatever"; gentle with animals and small children.
description: Bleached hair, a reputation from middle school, feeds the stray cats behind the gym. Everyone is scared of him except the cats.
appearance: Bleached hair growing out, untied tie, a scar through one eyebrow, plasters on his knuckles.
